item.title: github: Take GitHub Mobile with you on iPhone Duo
item.description:
GitHub Mobile now supports iPhone Duo, with an adaptive layout for the unfolded device and vertical tabs for navigating areas like Copilot, Pull Requests, Issues, and Notifications.

  • Source: GitHub
